content.text:
cd /workspace && git add App.js MERGEEVENTINGESTION/PROTOTYPE/services/ingestion/src/index.ts && git commit -m "fix: rename source 'stockholm' to 'stockholm-venues' and fix CTA button
Root cause:
- Source 'stockholm' contained MOCK sample events, NOT real stockholm.com events
- stockholm.com is blocked by Cloudflare, cannot be scraped directly
- CTA button showed generic 'Se event >' instead of source-specific text
Changes:
- Rename source from 'stockholm' to 'stockholm-venues' in ingestion
- Update FALLBACK_PROVIDERS in App.js to use new source key
- Update formatProviderLabel() to map new source key to label
- Add getCtaText() function for dynamic CTA button text per source
- Update CTA button to show source-specific labels
This clarifies:
- What the source actually represents (Stockholm venues, not stockholm.com)
- What action the CTA button triggers (source-specific labels)"
